intended_object: A natural action of a group G on the fibers of a functor F : C ⥤ FintypeCat: G acts on each F.obj X and every F.map f is G-equivariant. Equivalently, the action is a homomorphism G → Aut F. Inferred from the docstring and the module on fundamental groups of Galois categories.
explanation: The class requires F.map f (g • x) = g • F.map f x for all g, all morphisms f : X ⟶ Y and all x : F.obj X. This is exactly equivariance of every F.map f, i.e. naturality of the action, which is the standard notion. Nothing is missing or extra, and degenerate cases behave correctly. The condition would also make sense for functors into Type, but here it is set up for fiber functors of Galois categories, which take values in FintypeCat, and it is used in that setting (the IsFundamentalGroup characterisation). So the codomain is the natural one here and the definition is not too narrow.
